$comment: Facts about Robinhood Chain that the deployment record does not hold, read on chain (rpc.mainnet.chain.robinhood.com) on 2026-11-09. Core contract addresses never go here: they come from gully-core-4663.json.
name: Robinhood Chain
deployedAtBlockSource: The Vault's creation transaction 0x30aafacb…761a (Sourcify deployment record), block 109466287.
contractBlockTimeSource: Arbitrum Nitro: blocks carry l1BlockNumber (Ethereum), so NUMBER in the EVM is the Ethereum block, ~12 s (18 L1 blocks over 2000 L2 blocks of 0.1 s), 2026-11-09.
quoteTokenSource: None: pools quote in the native coin (nativeValueTransfers true), so the record names no quote ERC-20 (defaultQuote returns native).
reusedSource: Multicall3 at its canonical address; eth_getCode returned the same 3,813-byte runtime on Robinhood, Base and BNB, 2026-11-09. The deployment record does not list it because Gully Core did not deploy it.
